nodes.summary: Adds end-to-end MakerWorld multi-colour 3MF & AMS/Canvas support on Centauri Carbon 2 (colour 3D preview, spool matching, multi-colour G-code preview, smart prime tower bed placement via place_wipe_tower_on_bed), MakerWorld parametric model customizer (inline 3D preview, searchable 48+ font picker, 20-swatch + RGB colour picker, automatic WebView SSO, multi-colour AMS 3MF export), plus cloud re-auth, Agora camera, LAN upload, and stability fixes. nodes.title: v1.10.1 (48)
nodes.summary: Fixes slice completion sometimes staying on Slicing/PrintSetup instead of navigating to SlicePreviewScreen (immediate Screen.Preview transition before offscreen thumbnailing/archiving, removed EGL14.eglTerminate(EGL_DEFAULT_DISPLAY) from ThumbnailRenderer, synchronous SliceForegroundService state update + stale cancel/jobId=0L guards, and archived-path fallback when tapping the Slice complete notification), plus all v1.10.0 multi-colour AMS, MakerWorld parametric customizer, and prime tower placement features. Uploaded to Play internal track as completed (edit 07714278245451368962, sha1 a80b3f487eecb7b9cd008c4e0d5b4a5a7be2fcfa) with ProGuard mapping and native symbols.

nodes.title: v1.10.2 (49)
nodes.summary: Fixes prime tower extending past the build plate: stops forcing purge_in_prime_tower=1 (using enable_prime_tower=1 so CC2 keeps purge_in_prime_tower=0, flushing via M6211 into its waste chute with a compact tower) and adds post-Print::process() ensure_generated_wipe_tower_on_bed() in slice_jni.cpp to clamp the exact generated prime tower geometry (corners, ribs, brim, cone, extrusions) strictly inside the bed; includes all v1.10.1 post-slice preview navigation fixes and v1.10.0 multi-colour AMS + MakerWorld parametric customizer features. Uploaded to Play internal track as completed (edit 17281019097205255164, sha1 3cd877681e1b6197278f4945b1fae46bc88ce2a3) with ProGuard mapping and native symbols.

nodes.title: v1.10.3 (50)
nodes.summary: Fixes flat G-code preview after slicing: derives per-face 3D geometric normals via fragment-shader dFdx/dFdy on position-only G-code VBOs (zero extra memory) with tuned directional lighting contrast, adds ; CHANGE_LAYER / ;LAYER:<n> / ; FEATURE: / dynamic layer-height & line-width / G2-G3 arc / G90-G91 / sloped-Z / purge-line exclusion support in GcodePreviewParser, and keys SlicePreviewScreen layerCount by preview. Uploaded to Play internal track as completed (edit 05588796347937233377, sha1 a6ccd99be28a516c91ec4c7c183251898f83f9f3) with ProGuard mapping and native symbols.

nodes.title: v1.10.4 (51)

nodes.title: 16 KB page-aligned native libraries
nodes.summary: All native libraries are built 16 KB page aligned (Android 16 requirement, done with CameraX 1.4.2 in v1.9.0); any new native dependency has to keep that property.

nodes.title: apkpush / two-device adb discipline
nodes.summary: apkpush installs with -r -g -t over the pinned debug key (no uninstall, no data wipe), reconnects to the last wireless-debugging address, and lists devices; two phones are often attached at once, so always pass -s for anything read back.

nodes.title: JNI ↔ R8 keep rules
nodes.summary: Every Java type/method resolved by name from native code needs a -keep rule in android/app/proguard-rules.pro, in the same commit as the JNI change; -keep class X does not cover nested X$Y. v1.6.2 crashed in release because NativeLib$PreviewCallback had no rule while NativeLib$SliceCallback did. Verify with bundleRelease + a dex check, not only installDebug.

nodes.title: Never say 'YE3D' in user-facing text
nodes.summary: 'YE3D' is the developer's private name for their printer and means nothing to users: say 'Centauri Carbon 2' or 'cloud printing' in release notes, store copy, and UI text.

nodes.title: Release notes cap is 500 characters
nodes.summary: Play rejects the whole commit above 500 characters (v1.9.0 failed at 970 and needed a 402-char rewrite). The short shipped text lives in store_listing/metadata.md per version; the long changelog goes on the GitHub release.

nodes.title: Play edits expire in about an hour
nodes.summary: A Play listing edit lives roughly an hour, so it must be built and edits().commit()ed in one sitting — v1.9.0 lost a day to an expired staged edit. The AAB path is safe because upload_play_internal.py commits the edit it opens.

nodes.title: Public mirror snapshot flow
nodes.summary: Publish by snapshotting main into the public repo as one squashed, named commit per release (never pushing private history), then tag there — the private repo has no GitHub Actions, so a tag on origin alone builds nothing.

nodes.title: Release checklist
nodes.summary: Bump versionCode/versionName → bundleRelease + extractReleaseNativeSymbolTables + mergeReleaseNativeDebugMetadata → upload with scripts/upload_play_internal.py including --mapping and --native-symbols → commit, tag, push tag to the public repo so CI produces artifacts → store listing edit committed in the same session.

nodes.title: UI work needs a screenshot in the conversation
nodes.summary: adb screencap → pull → read the PNG so it renders in chat; a file path is not evidence. Getting onto a model needs Home → Local model (SAF) because adb VIEW intents land on Home; a ~770-byte cube 3MF is enough when the phone has no model.

nodes.title: secrets/build.properties (endpoints, client ids, Agora, RSA key)
nodes.summary: Gitignored build secrets injected as BuildConfig fields: cloud gateways and login URLs, cookie domains, client ids, the Elegoo RSA public key, the Agora App ID. Also the CI secret BUILD_PROPERTIES in both repos.
next: Any new secret(...) key in android/app/build.gradle.kts must be added to BUILD_PROPERTIES in both repos in the same change
